## UI evidence

Add screenshots/video for visible changes.

## Documentation

- [ ] Relevant files in `docs/` updated

## Safety / integrity checklist

- [ ] No secret or private data is committed
- [ ] NASA/demo/imported provenance remains explicit
- [ ] Thermal detections are not described as confirmed fires without evidence
- [ ] Model metrics are not generalized beyond their evaluation set
- [ ] Error/stale/insufficient-evidence states remain visible
